description:
Map LLM token budgets to estimated wall-clock time.

Uses model-specific calibration data (tokens/second, reasoning overhead,
tool-call latency) to estimate how long a task will actually take.
Bridges the gap between token-space (how agents reason) and time-space (what humans need).
Use token_cost_estimate instead when dollar cost matters too.

model.description: LLM model identifier. Unknown models fall back to generic estimates.

project.description: Optional project/repo identifier this estimate belongs to, for cross-project analytics.

reasoning_depth.description: Expected depth of chain-of-thought reasoning. Deep reasoning adds significant per-token latency.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier (minted by a calling agent/hook) used to deduplicate repeated estimate calls for the same task within a session.

task_label.description: Optional free-text label identifying the task this estimate is for (e.g. an issue key or short title). Surfaced on get_pending_estimates output for triage.

task_type.description: Optional task type for feedback matching.

tokens.description: Total number of tokens in the LLM request (prompt + completion).

tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls expected in the agentic loop. Each adds overhead latency.

name: token_time_bridge
